About the Role
We are looking for a Global Partnerships BD Lead to develop and manage strategic partnerships across priority global markets. Working closely with the Global Marketing team and local teams, you will negotiate commercially sound terms, protect brand budgets, and enable local teams to work with high-quality marketing, financial media, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) resources for brand marketing. Your work will help build viable and sustainable partnerships that strengthen the company's global brand presence.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop a global partnership resource pool across financial media, financial portals, KOLs, Web3, CFD, Fintech, sports/IP, lifestyle, YouTube channels, newsletters and community leaders. Proactively identify and engage high-quality global and regional partners to expand brand reach in priority markets.
- Build and maintain a global resource map covering each partnerâs vertical market, audience quality, commercial rates, historical performance, potential risks and long-term partnership value, so teams can make faster, better-informed selection decisions.
- Negotiate pricing, contract terms and renewals with partners and suppliers, representing the company in securing stronger benefits, better rates and sustainable long-term arrangements, including annual framework agreements and long-term partnership discounts.
- Evaluate commercial proposals against market benchmarks, audience fit, deliverables, exposure, content production, secondary distribution rights, exclusivity, usage rights and content ownership. Protect brand budgets from inflated pricing, low-quality traffic and inefficient allocation, and review payment milestones, cancellation terms, make-good mechanisms and contractual liabilities.
- Establish supplier selection and management processes, including onboarding and qualification standards, pricing review mechanisms, partner evaluation frameworks, approval workflows, performance tracking, post-campaign reviews and blacklist/watchlist mechanisms. Maintain resource pricing databases across markets to improve ROI.
- Guide local BD and Marketing teams on resource development, partnership strategy, supplier selection, pricing reviews and key proposals. Facilitate cross-market resource sharing to avoid duplicated procurement and wastage, and build effective global-local collaboration mechanisms.
- Represent the company in partner meetings, proposal discussions, negotiations and senior-level relationship management. Document successful partnership cases to replicate best practices, optimise or replace underperforming partnerships where appropriate, and apply strong brand awareness and compliance sensitivity across the regulatory requirements of CFD, online trading and financial services markets.

What Weâre Looking For
- Bachelorâs degree in business, marketing, communications or a related field, with a track record in partnerships, business development, media or KOL partnerships, sponsorships or supplier management.
- Proven commercial negotiation skills, with the ability to assess pricing, deliverables, contractual terms and ROI, and experience managing significant budgets across multiple international or regional markets.
- Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work with senior stakeholders, local teams and external partners across cultures. Strong written and spoken English is required.
- Good awareness of brand safety, advertising and compliance considerations in regulated financial services.
- Bonus: experience in CFD, trading, fintech or digital assets; established relationships across financial media, KOLs, events or sports/IP; Chinese proficiency for communicating with Chinese-speaking stakeholders and partners.

What We Offer
- Global exposure and the opportunity to shape partnership strategy across multiple markets, with learning and career development opportunities within a leading global trading platform.
- Competitive compensation and benefits package.
- A collaborative, international team environment where your commercial judgement directly influences how the companyâs brand investment is spent.

Location & Eligibility Note: This role is 100% Remote. While this listing uses "Paris" system tag as a location, we are actively hiring marketing talent based anywhere within European time zonesâincluding the UK, EU, and non-EU European countries.

RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Jr. UI Developer.

 

About RainFocus

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun and exciting. 

 

About the Role

As a Jr. UI Developer, you will be an essential part of our team, assisting in the implementation of stunning, user-friendly web applications. Working alongside experienced developers, you will use HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript to help translate designs into high-quality web experiences for our events and platforms. This position is ideal for an early-career developer who is passionate about visually-focused development, eager to learn best practices in CSS and JavaScript, and excited to collaborate within a supportive team environment. You will gain hands-on experience with branding, workflows, and enterprise-grade software development.

\n


How you will contribute:

  • Assist in developing, updating, and maintaining UI components and branding with a strong focus on design and responsiveness.

  • Collaborate closely with senior developers, designers, and Product Management to learn processes and deliver quality work.

  • Write clean, maintainable HTML, CSS (using SASS and utility classes), and basic JavaScript (including exposure to React and Svelte).

  • Help troubleshoot, debug, and fix styling issues or UI-related bugs across different browsers and devices.

  • Participate in code reviews to receive feedback, learn RainFocus coding standards, and improve your skills.

  • Support the team in configuring client white-labeling, templates, and basic event workflows.


Required Experience/ Skills:

  • 1â2 years of professional web development experience, or equivalent experience through bootcamps, internships, or robust portfolio projects.

  • Solid fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS, and CSS preprocessors like SASS.

  • Basic understanding of vanilla JavaScript and an eagerness to learn modern frameworks like React and Svelte.

  • Understanding of responsive design principles and cross-browser compatibility.

  • Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive mindset, self-motivated to ask questions, learn, and grow as a developer.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Works well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Exposure to design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Photoshop.

  • Basic awareness of web accessibility (WCAG) standards.

  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.

  • General understanding of how APIs or backend systems (like Java) interact with front-end code.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

MEYA HOLDINGS LTD is an international company specializing in digital assets, cryptocurrency markets, and financial research. We focus on developing data-driven trading approaches and optimizing market operations. Our remote team brings together professionals from different parts of the world.

We are looking for a motivated Junior Market Analyst with at least 1 year of experience in cryptocurrency or financial trading. You will assist with market analysis, monitor trading performance, and contribute to improving our daily operational processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor cryptocurrency prices, trading volumes, and market developments.
  • Analyze market data and identify potential trading opportunities.
  • Assist with daily Spot, Futures, and Options trading activities.
  • Monitor asset allocation across centralized and decentralized exchanges.
  • Prepare reports on market conditions and trading performance.
  • Identify operational or technical issues and coordinate with the relevant teams.
  • Monitor automated trading systems and ensure compliance with risk management rules.
  • Maintain accurate financial and operational records.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to improve trading processes.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with no geographical restrictions.
  • Flexible working hours across different time zones.
  • Access to professional trading platforms and analytical tools.
  • Opportunity to gain practical experience in digital asset markets.
  • Career development opportunities within an international company.
  • Friendly working environment with ongoing support and feedback.

Requirements

  • Basic understanding of spot, futures, and options markets.
  • Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work under pressure and make quick decisions.
  • Good communication skills in English (written and spoken).
  • Team player, adaptable, and self-organized.

Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000â$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.
